title: kb-agent-framework — A Minimal Typed Agent Runtime You Can Read in One Sitting
tagline: Microsoft just made agent-building an official skill track (AB-100 Agentic AI Solutions Architect, AB-620 AI Agent Builder). This is the runtime under the hood: a dependency-free TypeScript agent framework — typed tool registry, episodic + scratchpad memory, a step-guarded ReAct loop, and a structured trace. Watch the loop run live in your browser, zero API keys, then point it at Azure OpenAI with a BYOK adapter.
